area.text: H · Account, cloud, collaboration and product (Paper)

nH01.text:
H01 Sign in / create account

Optional sign-in that adds cloud storage, sync and shared review; local use never needs an account.

States: email entry (drawn), code sent, wrong or expired code, offline (sign-in unavailable, everything local still works), desktop: waiting for the system browser.

Todos: H2

nH02.text:
H02 Account and plan

One page for the account: [PLAN NAME] and [PRICE], the offline licence key for on-device features, signed-in devices, data export and deletion.

States: no plan (free trial or none), plan active (drawn), payment failed, key copied, device signed out, delete confirm.

Todos: H2, U5a

nH03.text:
H03 Cloud documents and upload consent

The Files home's Cloud tab lists the documents a signed-in user chose to upload, each with a sync status; nothing uploads without the per-document consent dialog.

States: synced, uploading, waiting for connection, conflict, empty (no cloud documents), quota nearly full, signed out.

Todos: H3, H4

nH04.text:
H04 Sync conflict and offline edits

When two devices save from the same revision, lamina keeps both (a conflict copy) and says so; offline saves wait in a queue and upload on reconnect.

States: conflict (drawn), offline queue (drawn), uploading queued saves, upload failed (retry).

Todos: H4

nH05.text:
H05 Share for review

Invite people or make a link to a cloud document, with a role each (viewer, commenter, editor), and revoke access.

States: local file (upload first), no one invited, invite sent, link on/off, revoked, role changed.

Todos: E18f

nH06.text:
H06 Shared review

Comment mode on a shared document: who is here, their selections, live comment threads, and the lease that guards content edits.

States: live (drawn), reconnecting, offline with queued comments (desktop), lease held by someone else (drawn), you hold the lease, access removed.

Todos: E18e, E18g

nH07.text:
H07 Notifications

New comments, replies, mentions and shares in an in-app panel, and the optional email that says the same.

States: unread (drawn), all read, empty, email off (default) or on per user.

Todos: E18f

nH08.text:
H08 Pricing and promises page

The docs-site page with the plans and prices the owner sets (placeholders here) and the fair-pricing promises beside them.

States: one page; prices are [PRICE] placeholders until the owner decides (U5a).

Todos: U5a

nH09.text:
H09 Benchmark page

The reproducible reader benchmark: method, machines, versions and results with raw data; numbers are [n ms] until U5b measures them.

States: results published (placeholders), product omitted for licence reasons, stale run (older than the current release).

Todos: U5b

nH10.text:
H10 Telemetry opt-in and what we collect

Off by default; a one-time question with the exact payload shown, and a settings pane where it can be turned on or off at any time.

States: prompt (web, drawn), settings pane (desktop, drawn), on, off, payload expanded.

Todos: U5c

nH11.text:
H11 Upgrade prompt before work starts

A feature outside the user's plan says so before any input: in the palette and menus as a plan label, and in a dialog when chosen, never after work.

States: prompt on choosing (drawn), plan label in palette (drawn), already on the plan (no prompt), offline.

Todos: U5a
